caption: The drawing depicts a seated male figure in a blue jacket, yellow vest, and brown trousers, with black shoes and a white shirt accented by a blue bow tie. The figure has short, dark hair, a mustache, and is positioned in a high-backed chair with red sides and a beige panel on the side. On the side panel of the chair, the words "TAMMANY BANK" are written in blue letters surrounding a fan-like motif. The man’s right arm is bent and raised with his hand in front of his chest, while the left arm is bent downward, resting on the armrest. The background is an off-white color with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature "Geo. J. Fila" is written in small letters at the bottom right of the image.
title: Metal Toy Bank: Tammany Bank
